title: UCP Request Constraints Check
description: Verify-only preflight of a pasted UCP request against a pasted set of ucp.request_constraints values (UCP 2026-08-25, tag v2026-08-25). Evaluates required, properties, anyOf, enum and const over the objects each value path selects, using a minimal inline RFC 9535 subset (root, child member, index, wildcard, equality filters joined by &&). Returns SATISFIED, VIOLATED or INDETERMINATE and lists each violated constraint with its path and reason. Unsupported paths, malformed values and contradictory constraints are INDETERMINATE, never a guess. Never fetches a profile, a key or a merchant endpoint.

request.description: The UCP request the Platform is about to send, pasted as JSON. Bounded to 20000 JSON nodes and 64 levels of nesting in total with the constraints.

constraints.description: ucp.request_constraints values from the last authoritative response, max 64. Missing or empty means nothing to check (SATISFIED, NOT_EVALUATED note).

request_constraints.description: One ucp.request_constraints value: optional RFC 9535 path plus required, properties, anyOf, enum, const.

ambient_path.description: Normalized Path of the response object that held ucp, used only when the value omits path. Defaults to $.

output_example.scope_note: Verify-only preflight. Both documents are caller-pasted; no profile, key or merchant endpoint is fetched. SATISFIED covers only the constraint values this node could evaluate and says nothing about the resolved request schema or Business runtime rules. Path support is a subset of RFC 9535 (root, child member, index, wildcard, equality filters joined by &&); anything else is INDETERMINATE with UNSUPPORTED_PATH. Instances that are not objects satisfy required and properties vacuously, as in JSON Schema.
